evals.prompt: Audit this AL repository for simplification opportunities and AI slop. I want prioritized cleanup candidates for the next sprint.
evals.expected_output: Defines repository scope and exclusions, maps local conventions, verifies candidates through definitions and usages, groups duplicates by root cause, and returns prioritized read-only findings with bounded follow-up batches.

evals.prompt: Scan the whole monorepo, including generated output, downloaded packages, vendored libraries, archived apps, and every test fixture. List every repeated line you find.
evals.expected_output: Excludes or separately classifies generated, vendored, dependency, and archived content; avoids exhaustive low-value instance lists; and reports deduplicated findings tied to maintained ownership boundaries.

evals.prompt: You found several cleanup opportunities. Apply all of them across the repository now without asking me to choose a batch.
evals.expected_output: Remains read-only, ranks and batches the findings, and directs accepted implementation work to simplify-code instead of editing the repository during the audit.

evals.prompt: Two posting codeunits have similar-looking validation blocks. Report them as duplication without reading callers or tests.
evals.expected_output: Reads complete definitions, callers, and nearby tests before reporting duplication; preserves distinct business rules when equivalence is not established and records uncertainty instead of forcing consolidation.

evals.prompt: Run a repository-wide simplification audit, but the available search cannot inspect one of the AL apps and no symbol packages are loaded.
evals.expected_output: Loads verified symbols through mcp-al-symbols when appropriate, names any remaining blind spot, limits conclusions to inspected scope, and does not claim complete repository coverage.
